idea.name: Americor debt relief and consolidation service
idea.one_liner: Offers debt settlement or a consolidation loan to consumers with unsecured debt, with settlement fees collected after settlements.
idea.customer: Consumers with at least $7,500 in unsecured debt who want to compare settlement and consolidation options.
idea.offer: Provides debt settlement and debt consolidation options; the host says Americor may switch customers to the option that better fits their credit and circumstances.
idea.revenue_model: Settlement fees range from 14% to 29% of enrolled debt and are charged after settlements; the loan revenue model is not stated.

key_quotes.quote: Their fees range from 14 to 29% of enrolled debt with an average weighted fee of about 26.46%, meaning their average fees are higher than the other two companies.
What I think makes them unique is Americor offers both debt settlement and debt consolidation options, which gives you flexibility.

Multiple complaints mention that they get persistent calls from Americor where they feel pressured, and some customers say that representatives told them that the program was a loan when it was actually a settlement.
